scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @pullet-studio/api && npm run test --workspace @pullet-studio/api
scripts.test:boards: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.boards.config.ts
scripts.test:workflows: npm run build && npm run test:workflow-graph && playwright test --config playwright.workflows.config.ts
scripts.test:settings: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.settings.config.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write apps/api/src apps/web/src tools tests playwright.config.ts playwright.boards.config.ts playwright.workflows.config.ts playwright.settings.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps/api/src apps/web/src tools tests playwright.config.ts playwright.boards.config.ts playwright.workflows.config.ts playwright.settings.config.ts
